title: Social Media Advertising Agencies That Also Make the Ads
summary: Some agencies make the ads and run them, others bill creative apart from media. Compare seven providers by content, ad management and published pricing.
body_markdown:
## Which other agencies make the content and run the ads?


Six providers from our research combine content and paid social. Each one's pages show what it makes and how it manages ads, as of October 2026.


### Adside AI


Adside AI sells a managed service as well as software. As of October 2026, its pricing page lists the managed service at 10% of ad spend with a $3,500 monthly minimum, and its FAQ says that one fee covers strategy, creative production, launch, optimization and reporting ([Adside AI pricing](https://www.adside.ai/pricing) ). The page names Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit and Twitter as places it can run your ads, and says there are no per-creative fees.


It does not state how many creatives the fee includes, so ask for a count. Because the fee is a percentage of spend, it scales with your budget, so model it at your planned spend before you decide. Our[Adside alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/adside-alternatives) compares it with other options.


### Chamber Media


Chamber Media's own FAQ says to expect at least about $5K to $10K a month for creative development, strategy and management, as of October 2026 ([Chamber Media](https://chamber.media/) ). It runs campaigns from your own ad accounts on month-to-month terms, and its creative covers short-form video, UGC and static ads. Chamber is a good fit for a brand that wants creative and media from one team, with a month-to-month term as the page describes it. See our[Chamber Media alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/chamber-media-alternatives) for other options at that level.


### Thrive


Thrive has worked on social media advertising since 2005 and covers Facebook and Instagram alongside LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit ([Thrive](https://thriveagency.com/social-media-advertising/) ). Its team includes designers, content specialists and videographers, and it produces multiple creative variations for testing. The page lists no long-term contracts. Its fees are not published, and the FAQ says they are tailored to your budget and needs. Thrive is the most natural choice here for local and multi-location businesses, which the page names first.


### Voy Media


Voy Media lists Facebook and Instagram ads first among its platforms, with a creative studio alongside. As of October 2026, its Creative Studio page covers UGC, at-home creators, full studio production with script, talent and art direction, and photography ([Voy Media Creative Studio](https://voymedia.com/services/creative-studio/) ). Its pricing page says packages are based on total ad spend and publishes no figures ([Voy Media pricing](https://voymedia.com/pricing/) ). Voy is worth a look if you want a Facebook-first agency that makes its own content, but get the scope in writing.


### MuteSix


MuteSix runs paid social on Instagram, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat and Pinterest, with retail media, paid search and lifecycle marketing alongside. As of October 2026, its Facebook page describes creative from its in-house StudioSix team and a network of Instagram and Facebook creators and influencers ([MuteSix Facebook ads](https://mutesix.com/services/facebook-ad-agency/) ). Its production page covers live action, animation and iPhone-shot social content, and it offers a production-only package for brands that buy media elsewhere ([MuteSix](https://mutesix.com/) ). Pricing is not published. Our[MuteSix alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/mutesix-alternatives) covers the trade-offs.


### Creative Milkshake


Creative Milkshake says it combines data-driven strategy with creative to make paid social ads. As of October 2026, it mixes studio and creator production, offers media buying across Meta, TikTok and YouTube, and makes ads in English, Spanish, German, French, Dutch, Italian and Portuguese ([Creative Milkshake](https://www.creativemilkshake.com/) ). Its performance creative page lists UGC ads, product demos, before-and-after ads, founder stories, problem-solution ads and hook-testing ads, and its locations page lists hubs in Amsterdam, London, Paris, Berlin, Dublin and Stockholm. Pricing, minimums and turnaround are not published. It is worth a look if you need the same ad in several European languages.


## Which model fits which brand?


The content model should follow the proof your ad needs. If the ad must show a real person using the product, pick a creator network. Common Thread Collective's UGC packages, for example, contain 20 ads from 5 creators, 40 from 10 or 80 from 20, with three to four weeks per batch ([Common Thread Collective](https://commonthreadco.com/pages/creative-production) ). inBeat sources creators for fit, writes hooks and scripts, and runs whitelisted ads through creator handles, with usage rights defined before production ([inBeat UGC agency](https://inbeat.agency/ugc-agency) ).


If the ad is a brand statement, a feature story or a demo, AI video can carry it. Knowlify makes that kind of ad with AI presenters and 3D animation, not with real customers. Be clear about which kind you need before you compare quotes, because the two are priced differently.


Scale matters too.[Darkroom](https://www.darkroomagency.com/services/performance-creative) states a fit of $10M to $500M in revenue and a poor fit for single-channel brands under roughly $5M. Chamber Media's minimum is $5K to $10K a month. Ask each provider how many distinct concepts it delivers a month, since Meta's engineering team expects the number of ad creatives in its systems to grow significantly ([Meta's Andromeda engineering post](https://engineering.fb.com/2024/12/02/production-engineering/meta-andromeda-advantage-automation-next-gen-personalized-ads-retrieval-engine/) ).


Our[social media advertising agency buyer guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/social-media-advertising-agency) covers the selection steps in more detail.


## Key takeaways


- "Makes the content" can mean an in-house studio, a creator network, a managed fee or creative billed separately. Ask which one you are buying.
- Knowlify is our top pick if you want finished AI video ads made and run on Meta, from $5,000 a month, a person checking every ad and a 90-day refund guarantee (terms on the site). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.
- Adside AI puts creative inside one fee at 10% of ad spend with a $3,500 monthly minimum, as of October 2026.
- Match the content model to the proof your ad needs: real creators for real customers, AI video for brand statements and demos.
- Ask every agency for distinct concepts a month, not only the number of files.


## FAQ


### What does a social media agency that makes content cost?


Published floors vary widely. Adside AI charges 10% of ad spend with a $3,500 monthly minimum, and its one fee covers creative production. Chamber Media says to expect about $5K to $10K a month at minimum for creative, strategy and management. Knowlify starts at $5,000 a month.


### Do agencies that make content also buy the media?


Some do and some do not. Common Thread Collective sells its ad creative separately from its Meta buying. Chamber Media runs campaigns from your own ad accounts. Ask whether creative and media sit in one contract and who owns the ad accounts.


### Are the UGC videos from an agency made by real creators?


Often. inBeat and Common Thread Collective both use creators, and inBeat defines usage rights before production begins. Knowlify makes AI UGC with AI presenters and does not supply real human creators, so match the provider to the proof your ad needs.


### How many new ads should a social agency deliver each month?


Meta's engineering team expects the number of ad creatives in its systems to grow significantly, so volume matters. inBeat's paid social page says it typically plans[8 to 15 new concepts a month](https://inbeat.agency/paid-social-agency) , with 2 to 4 variations of each. Ask every provider for distinct concepts a month, not just finished files.
